summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests MRX-2843, a capsule taken by mouth, in adolescents and adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, or mixed phenotype acute leukemia. Patients take MRX-2843 once daily in 28-day cycles, with dose levels increased in predefined cohorts. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the title says the study evaluates safety and how the body processes the drug (pharmacokinetics).
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa MRX-2843, una cápsula que se toma por vía oral, en adolescentes y adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda, leucemia linfoblástica aguda o leucemia aguda de fenotipo mixto recidivante o refractaria. Los pacientes toman MRX-2843 una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, y las dosis aumentan en grupos predefinidos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el título señala que el estudio evalúa la seguridad y la forma en que el cuerpo procesa el medicamento (farmacocinética).
who_for: Male or female, at least 12 years old, weighing at least 40 kg.
Confirmed AML, ALL, or MPAL in second or later relapse, or refractory to at least one induction regimen.
ECOG performance status 0-2, or Lansky/Karnofsky score of 50 or higher.
For the FLT3-ITD expansion cohort, prior treatment with at least one FLT3 inhibitor.
not_for: Known active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Treatment-dose anticoagulants or antiplatelet agents (low-dose aspirin and prophylactic heparin are allowed).
